data.name: Manis
data.gender_notes: Manis is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manis is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mani', which means 'gem', 'jewel', or 'precious stone'. This name is often associated with wealth, abundance, and beauty. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Lakshmi, who embodies prosperity, is often depicted holding a lotus filled with precious gems, including manis. The name Manis carries the meaning “Jewel, Gem” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manis usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, gem and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing inner richness and beauty.
data.etymology: Manis belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel, Gem.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manis total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
